# Sell 100 USD held at 1.40 for 139.00 CAD: a 1.00 CAD loss.
# The USD split is valued at the cost of the basis it picks (140.00 CAD), the
# CAD split states what the sale fetched (139.00), and $residual$ takes the
# difference. {basis_guid} is filled in from `fx-balances`.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 100 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-140.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis_guid}"
	Assets:Bank 139.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "139.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
